FULL TEXT:
Engagement of Professionals as Professors of Practice
About Us
The Reserve Bank of India had set up, Institute for Development and Research
in Banking Technology (the Institute) on June 10, 1996 as a Society under the Society
Registration Act. The objective of the Institute was to spearhead technology absorption
in the banking and financial sector of the country. In its credit’, the Institute had
developed grounds-up and managed digital infrastructure such as a) ATM-NFS
network, b) INFINET, SFMS, RTGS, NEFT, IBCC (Inter Bank Community Cloud)
[these were hived off on its maturity to NPCI and IFTAS in 2010 and 2015 respectively],
development of standard and protocols for Mobile banking, Micro ATM, etc. and
continue to function as Certifying Authority for digital certificates for banks and
government. The research and academic activities provided the technical know-how
for the adoption and absorption of these services and trained manpower for the
banking industry as well.
The Institute has set up Research Centers for aiding and promoting research
and development work. The Research Centers are being constantly upgraded to keep
pace with the ever-changing technology trends. Further details about us can be
accessed at https://www.idrbt.ac.in/about-idrbt/ .
Intent
With an objective to collaborate with the industry and professionals involved in
technological domains, the Institute intend to engage with them as “Professor of
Practice” (PoP). A formal academic qualification is not considered essential for this
position if they have exemplary professional practice in lieu. In general, resumes of
experienced industry professionals do not necessarily meet the traditional criteria for
awarding a faculty position in the Institute. To this end, we have created a cadre as
Professor of Practice (PoP).
This is also in line with National Education Policy 2020 and UGC guidelines to
take real world practices and experiences into the classrooms, enhance the faculty
resources in higher education institutions and also augment the adoption and
absorption of emerging technology through applied research.
Scope
It is aimed that Professor of Practice will bring synergy
a) To develop courses, curriculum and include hands-on components to meet the
demand of skilled manpower in banking sector
b) To bring in distinguished experts in technology, entrepreneurship,
management, public policy, human psychological behaviour, etc. into the
Institute
c) To enable the Institute to formally associate with persons of eminence and
encourage adoption of the best set of Industry practices within the banking
sector
d) To design and teach niche topics at the intersection of cutting-edge technology
and foundational academic pedagogy
e) To define research problems for PhD students that are of particular relevance
and interest to Industry.
Expectations
The Professors of Practice are expected to play key pedagogical and
leadership roles in the development in applied research and study programs for faster
adoption of technology in the banking sector for public good.
Across the Institute which includes developing facilities and labs, courses and
programs, engage faculty, incubate applied research leading to credible publications
and patents by reaching out to industries. PoP will also contribute to activities and
design projects, encourage and promote active learning, creativity, innovations, etc. at
the Institute.
PoP technology and other allied fields with a deeper understanding of the
practical applications will serve as liaison between the industry, engage with industry
and academia for collaborations a with the institute in identifying development and
research that support societal needs, public goods and creation of digital public
infrastructure. They may also facilitate for arranging PhD fellowships funded in part or
entirely by the industry for faster adoption of technology from lab and research to
production and adoption leading to better operational efficiency in BFSI Sector. They
will also facilitate an environment for students and faculty colleagues alike to nurture
provide necessary mentorship for activities like use of technology for enhancement in
operational efficiency and augment customer reach and satisfaction through exhibition
off entrepreneurship and creativity.
Professor of Practice is not open for those in teaching profession - serving or
retired.
Appointment and mode of Engagement
The Professor of Practice is a non-tenured appointment. The offer will be initially
for a period of three years, which is extendable based on performance and
contribution. However, an industry professional may apply for short-term (1 to 2 years)
PoP with the Institute against an appropriate leave his/her regular position in the
industry.
Eligibility
Professionals such as CEO, CTO, Principal Scientists, Senior Research
Scientists with at least a master’s degree in engineering, science, or a related field can
be considered for the position of Professor of Practice. A PhD is desirable but not
mandatory. the lack of a PhD might be offset by the demonstrated domain knowledge
obtained from deep experience in the developmental activities/contributions for
adoption and absorption of niche emerging technologies. Individuals with an
appropriate Bachelor degree having exceptional footprints in the area of
entrepreneurship may also be considered as PoP.
Those who have proven expertise in their specific profession or role with at
least 15 years of service/experience, preferably at a senior level, will be eligible for
Professor of Practice. These experts will also be exempted from the requirement of
publications and other eligibility criteria stipulated for the recruitment of faculty
members at the Professor level.
Age Limit
67 years as on August 31, 2024.
Compensation
The compensation of a Professor of Practice will depend on the nature of the
appointment and the expertise he / she brings in and the market trend for such
expertise. The Consolidated amount for Part-time/Full-time engagement would be
mutually agreed between the Institute and the Expert and will normally be in sync with
the UGC level of scales.
Experts fulfilling the eligibility criteria for the Professor of Practice may like to
share their expertise with students and come forward to teach on honorary basis.
How to Apply
Interested candidates may apply by giving their detailed application in the
prescribed format. The candidates must sign the given declaration separately. The
filled-up application form and the scanned copy of the signed declaration (separate
PDF files for application and declaration) shall by email on careers@idrbt.ac.in . The
applications will be held in strict confidence. Please note that maximum file size limit
is 10 MB.
Process for Selection
i. The non-tenure appointment of a PoP will be done through the Search-cum-
selection Committee of the Institute.
ii. The Search-cum-selection Committee constituted by the Institute to assist in
the search of PoP reserves the right to reject any or all applications and/or to
recommend the name of a suitable person by invitation.
iii. Shortlisted applicants will appear for interactions with the Search Committee on
prescribed date after a communication from the Institute through the email
provided in application form about date and venue of the interaction.
iv. Candidature will be considered on the strength of the information declared in
the application.
v. Based on the interaction, the Search-cum-selection Committee will give its
recommendation.
vi. Individual privacy concerns of the applicants will be ensured by the Institute to
the extent possible.
vii. This is a rolling advertisement.
